task: Locator-resolvability repair map for the fourth frozen class (AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH) at pinned L1, completing BL-4 decision support for all four classes.
why: BL-4 leaves the G-LIT criterion 'ledger rows have resolvable locators' ambiguous at ledger/citation_audit.csv#315c19145065 because 67/97 exact_locator cells are search queries or elisions. worker-050 delivered decision support for AF-WCC-VAC-GEN (12 rows: wcc_locator_resolution) and for every SCC-bound row (34 rows: scc_locator_readiness). The 10 rows whose class_mapping is exactly AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH were in neither scope (they carry no SCC token and are not AF-WCC-VAC-GEN); 8 of the 10 carry a weak exact_locator. This artifact measures that remaining class so the BL-4 ruling has full four-class coverage.
population_rule: Data rows of the pinned ledger whose class_mapping.strip() == 'AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH' (pure class, no co-mapped token). Derived from the ledger alone before any fetch.

locator_classification_rule.weak: exact_locator empty, or contains 'search_query=', or contains '/api/literature?q=', or contains a literal '...' elision
locator_classification_rule.direct: any other non-empty URL that is not a search endpoint and not elided
locator_classification_rule.note: the rule uses only the row's own exact_locator string; no ledger prose is used as evidence

proposal_rule: For each row, take the first non-empty single-record candidate in field order evidence_url -> url -> doi (prefixed https://doi.org/) -> arxiv_id (prefixed https://arxiv.org/abs/); reject any candidate that is a search endpoint or contains an elision. Proposals are computed from the ledger's own columns, never invented.

fetch_rule.pass_2: independent re-fetch of every row proposal and every control against the live source; pass-2 bodies are stored separately and never reused from pass 1

thresholds.title_match: normalized title equality OR normalized containment (either direction) OR token-F1 >= 0.75; normalization is NFKD-ascii-fold, lower-case, LaTeX/HTML stripped, non-alphanumeric collapsed
thresholds.row_confirmed: pass-1 and pass-2 both HTTP 200, both parse to a title that matches the ledger title, and the proposal collides with no other row's exact_locator/evidence_url/url
thresholds.row_failed: either pass returns HTTP 200 with a non-matching title
thresholds.row_unverified: a pass fails to return HTTP 200, or the proposal is missing/not single-record

C1_positive_penrose_1965.expected: HTTP 200, title matches 'Gravitational collapse and space-time singularities' (proves the matcher can accept)

C2_negative_mutant_doi.expected: not HTTP 200, or HTTP 200 with a title that does NOT match any reference title (proves the matcher can reject)

C3_cross_source_src075.expected: both sources independently return HTTP 200 and a title matching the SRC-075 ledger title

falsifiers: F1 any proposal that does not resolve to the cited work (title mismatch) voids that row's CONFIRMED verdict
F2 a row classified weak whose exact_locator is in fact a single-record resolvable locator voids the classification for that row
F3 any change to ledger/citation_audit.csv away from 315c19145065 voids the whole table; the runner exits 3 and fetches nothing
F4 a pass-2 observation that differs from pass-1 in HTTP status or returned record voids the row's stability claim until re-fetched
F5 a proposal that collides with another row's exact_locator/evidence_url/url voids the per-row uniqueness reading for that proposal
F6 control C1 failing to match or C2 matching would void the instrument, not the ledger
authority: Worker evidence only. Not a ledger edit, not a G-LIT gate verdict, not an L1-node completion, not a validation_status. The canonical ledger is owned by astra-lead-literature; applying any repair moves the L1 hash and voids the current qualifying spot checks (BL-4 option ii).
stop_rule: One preregistration, one runner, two fetch passes, one readiness map, one checkpoint and at most four outbox events; then exit.
